biography: Max Robinson, a ginger blur on the British karting scene, hails from a small village in Oxfordshire. His racing journey began at the age of eight, after his grandfather, a retired mechanic, gifted him a battered kart found rusting in a barn. The first time Max wrestled the kart around the makeshift track in a muddy field, nearly crashing into a startled flock of sheep, he was hooked. His early karting career was marked by flashes of brilliance interspersed with spectacular crashes – a pattern that continues to define his unpredictable talent. Moving up to single-seaters at 15, he’s shown raw speed, but consistency remains his Achilles' heel. Currently competing as an independent driver in the Formula Regional British Championship, Robinson is searching for the funding and stability to realize his potential, proving that he is more than just a crash waiting to happen.
drivingStyle: Robinson is an instinctive, aggressive driver, often described as 'seat-of-the-pants.' He attacks corners with a fearless commitment, frequently pushing the limits of grip and occasionally exceeding them. His tire management is a work in progress; while he can extract immense pace early in a stint, his tires often fade dramatically towards the end. Under pressure, Robinson can either rise to the occasion with breathtaking overtakes or crumble with unforced errors, making him an exciting but unpredictable competitor.

rivalries.reason: A consistent front-runner, Dubois represents everything Robinson isn’t: calculated, methodical, and reliable. Their contrasting styles clash fiercely on track.
Thorne, a wealthy pay driver, has openly mocked Robinson's independent status and lack of sponsorship, fueling a personal and professional rivalry.

Petrova and Robinson have had several on-track altercations, resulting in ruined races for both. Their animosity stems from a controversial incident at Silverstone where Robinson punted Petrova off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, even though they have holes.
Listens to heavy metal at full volume right before a race to 'get in the zone'.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days.
famousQuote: "You only live once, so might as well send it!"
careerHighlight: Winning the British Karting Championship final in 2022, after starting from the back of the grid due to a mechanical issue in qualifying; an improbable victory that showcased his raw talent and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of a Formula Regional race at Brands Hatch, costing him a potential breakthrough win and valuable championship points; the crash was entirely his fault, due to overeagerness.
